result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a wide roadway with embedded trolley tracks and a marked zebra crosswalk at a signalized intersection. While sidewalks are present on both sides, the lack of dedicated pedestrian signals and the presence of tracks create potential hazards for those crossing.

hazards.name: Trolley Tracks
hazards.description: Embedded tracks in the roadway can be a trip hazard or slippery for pedestrians, especially in wet conditions.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and right side of the roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No visible pedestrian-specific signals at the intersection, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle traffic lights.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the crosswalk may obscure pedestrians from the view of oncoming drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street near the crosswalk

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information and improve safety.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the intersection to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light, reducing conflicts with turning traffic.

result.summary: A complex multi-leg intersection featuring trolley tracks and overhead wires. The environment has wide crossing distances and minimal pavement markings, increasing pedestrian exposure to vehicular traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide, multi-leg intersection requires pedestrians to be in the roadway for an extended period without a refuge.

hazards.name: Trolley Tracks
hazards.description: Embedded tracks can be slippery when wet and present a tripping hazard for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of Lane Markings
hazards.description: The absence of clear lane markings can lead to unpredictable vehicle movements within the large intersection.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install bold, continental-style crosswalk markings at all legs of the intersection to increase pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Construct raised islands between the tracks or travel lanes to provide a safe waiting area mid-crossing.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized intersection in a residential area featuring streetcar tracks and basic pedestrian infrastructure. A large utility truck is parked near the crosswalk, creating a significant visual obstruction between pedestrians and approaching traffic.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A large utility truck is parked at the corner, blocking the sightlines between drivers and pedestrians entering the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway at the intersection

hazards.name: Streetcar Tracks
hazards.description: Embedded tracks in the roadway can cause tripping for pedestrians or catch bicycle tires.

hazards.name: Faded Markings
hazards.description: The crosswalk paint is significantly worn, reducing its visibility to approaching motorists.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near the intersection to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade the faded parallel lines to continental-style high-visibility markings.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and prevent illegal parking near the crosswalk.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized intersection in a mixed-use area with a high-visibility zebra crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides. While basic infrastructure is present, there is a lack of visible dedicated pedestrian signals and physical traffic calming measures like curb extensions.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No visible pedestrian-specific signal heads at a signalized intersection, which can lead to confusion about when it is safe to cross.

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The crossing distance across the roadway lacks a median refuge or curb extensions to minimize exposure to traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to improve clarity and safety for crossing pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to reduce the crossing distance and increase visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.
